summary: Placement run 43391935925 journaled the server's reply to BuyRoom2 sent as a GET: HTTP 405 (method not allowed), with an empty body. No room appeared and nothing was spent; the first run, 43389706745, failed the same way. The owner's capture records a GET, but the client's other room-changing calls (UpgradeRoom2, CollectAllResources) are POSTs with query parameters. placeRoom now sends the same query, in the same order, as a POST.  The capture file is left unedited. Its README row, the request-shape test and SPEC-13's evidence record the deviation and why.

contract_status_changes.after: BuyRoom2 sent as POST with the captured query
proof: live evidence: runs 43389706745 and 43391935925 got HTTP 405 for GET (journaled server_reply in the second)
request-shape test asserts POST and that the capture still records GET; full suite 1369 OK; make lint, spec_trace, git diff --check pass

residual_risks: POST is inferred from the 405 and the client's other room calls; the next placement run confirms it.
